events.name: Bash
events.head: Show related tasks and find capture scripts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate guide check script, capture pipeline and slot files
events.input: $ git ls-files | grep -E "check-guides|walkthroughs/|capture" | grep -v node_modules | head -40; git grep -n -I "Add new user" -- ':!*.json' | head -15; git ls-files | grep -E "s1-cold-email" | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the slot definition and existing capture helpers
events.input: $ sed -n 56,70p app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-cold-email.ts | cut -c1-260; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E "guide|shot|redact|blur|t115|t-115" ; ls scripts/walkthroughs 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls workshop-plan/tasks/staged | head -30; file app/public/guides/s1-cold-email/03.webp; grep -rn -i "blur" -l app/scripts scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the walkthrough capture pipeline and guide check rules
events.input: $ wc -l scripts/walkthroughs/{helper.js,cap.py,WORKFLOW.md,rec-helper.js} app/scripts/check-guides.mjs; sed -n 1,60p scripts/walkthroughs/WORKFLOW.md | cut -c1-300; echo ----; grep -n -E "function |window\.|blur|redact" scripts/walkthroughs/helper.js | head -40; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p scripts/walkthroughs/cap.py | cut -c1-200; echo ---; grep -n "shots: \[" -A4 app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-cold-email.ts | sed -n 1,14p | cut -c1-220; grep -n -i -E "size|width|bytes|capture_needed|FAIL" app/scripts/check-guides.mjs | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read blur helper, shot entry format and image conventions
events.input: $ cat scripts/walkthroughs/helper.js | cut -c1-330; sed -n 72,76p app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-cold-email.ts | cut -c1-600; grep -n -i -E "webp|sharp|quality|width" app/scripts/shoot-guides.mjs | head -12; python3 -c "
